findings.text: follow-on: the EXIT trap that removes the node-local scratch does not run on SIGTERM, so cancelling job 1288118 by id left the scratch tree on 98dci4-clu-3141 to be reclaimed only by tmp-sweep after 6 h (report.md:89); disclosed, and no evidence is affected.

follow-on: mapfile over the empty added_ids list yields one empty element, so the alone-run loop iterated once with an empty id and launched empty-id pytest invocations after the measurement was already final, and the line 'added ids: 1' in alone-runs.log misreports the empty list (report.md:82-88); the authoritative added-ids.json holds added_count 0, added_ids [].

item_verdicts.diff: the node made no commits - git log 5801e46e0f2977affae82063c9f0df49a8a669cc..HEAD in its worktree is empty and its tree is clean - so there is no product diff to read, consistent with its brief stating it changes no product code and commits nothing.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's evidence fence requires two logs naming revision, host, command, the arm's own imported reckon.__file__ and resolved cwd, carrying pytest's summary and ending in EXIT=, with the added ids derived by the candidate reader after a log-presence check; population-base.log and population-cand.log each carry all of those (verified by their headers and tails) and derive_added.py aborts on a missing log, a log with no summary line, or a None count.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to measure whether merging 4e8161114 onto main adds any failing test id over the whole importer population; its report.md and manifest.md record both arms (base 120 files, candidate 121 files) run in exclusive all_debug job 1288118 with added_count 0, which is that measurement.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it records both arms' pass/fail counts with log paths, added failing ids as none, the one file absent at base, and two self-disclosed scaffolding defects (job 1288116 and the empty-id alone loop) with their attribution.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declares its report directory under crew/reports/reckon/the-suite-is-green-at-head/failing-id-read-whole-population-at-merge (manifest.md:3) plus the run directory its host line grants for logs; every artefact it wrote lies in one of the two and its worktree is clean, so nothing is outside scope.

justifications.durability: derive_added.py:29-38 aborts when a log is missing, lacks a summary line, or yields a None count, so a vanished log cannot read as zero, but the measurement is a scratch script re-run by no suite and adds no committed guard of its own.
justifications.evidence: population-base.log and population-cand.log carry revision, host, literal command, the module_under_test proof, measurement_cwd and EXIT=1 with 1 failed/1248 passed and 1 failed/1252 passed, and I reproduced the added-failure derivation from those two logs with reckon/crew/review.py:2108 returning (0, []), each arm's positive control yielding exactly one parsed id.
justifications.fit: derive_added.py and run_population.sh name their arms and files by what they do and carry no plan label, deliverable id, ticket reference or AI attribution, and the report's plan-section citation (report.md:3) is document prose, not source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: report.md records both arms over the 121-file population (120 at base, the new test file absent there) in exclusive job 1288118, which is the goal's measurement.
justifications.reuse: derive_added.py calls reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs and gate_log_failure_ids rather than hand-rolling the FAILED/ERROR extraction, so the derivation extends the owner of that capability instead of duplicating it.
justifications.scope_discipline: nothing under reckon/ or tests/ changed (git status clean in the reviewed worktree at 5801e46e0) and every written path lies in the declared report directory or the run directory.
